title: Split Product Hero Nocturne badge contrast

finding.rootCause: The badge used the light-surface muted-ink token on the component's dark Nocturne canvas.

reproduction: Open /preview/?resource=split-product-hero&variant=nocturne in the Sites Worker preview.
Run the WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 A/AA Axe scan.
Observe a serious color-contrast finding on the uppercase badge.

fix.change: Use neutral-400 text for the badge in the Nocturne variant; retain the semantic muted token for the light variants.

regressionTest: tests/e2e/gold-resource-accessibility-certification.spec.ts — Split Product Hero Nocturne keeps its badge readable on the dark canvas
